observations: The page number «73» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.», the points after «hist», «filos» and «Afd» printed faintly, on the left, and the sheet number «10» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line. L01 completes the sentence that ends p. 72 (JP2 0104, L35), «da der».

L01-L04 and N01-N02. Checked: when the point of the ecliptic of longitude 25°, right ascension 23° 5′ 49″ (p. 72), culminates, the point of the equator a quadrant east of the meridian, of right ascension 113° 5′ 49″, is on the horizon of the right sphere; and in the right sphere, whose horizon passes through the poles, the points of the ecliptic and of the equator of the same right ascension rise together, as note 1 says.

L13-L27. Checked: with ε = 23° 51′, a declination of 23° 50′ 47″ gives by sin a = tg δ · cot ε a right ascension 1° 3′ 28″ from the solstice, 23° 50′ 46″ gives 1° 5′ 52″ (Suter: 1° 3′ 30″ and 1° 5′ 55″); the declinations of 89°, 88° and 87° computed from ε are 23° 50′ 46.1″, 23° 50′ 4.5″ and 23° 48′ 55.0″, and 23° 50′ 5″ and 23° 48′ 55″ give 2° 10′ 33″ and 3° 16′ 48″ (Suter: 2° 10′ 34″, 3° 16′ 48″). Computed from the longitudes 271°-273° directly the right ascensions from the beginning of Capricorn are 1° 5′ 36″, 2° 11′ 12″ and 3° 16′ 46″. Cancer is opposite Capricorn, so its right ascensions are those of Capricorn increased by 180°. The values of Tables 23, 24 and 59a are to be compared with the tables.

L22-L25: Suter's values, set in two columns under the heads «Steinbock :» and «Krebs :», each head centred over its column. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the columns room and are not printed. L28-L30: the heading of chapters 26 and 26a, in bold, centred, in two lines, with the reference to the text below it; «26a», «59a», «59b», the letters raised.

The dashes: L15 «1°—2°», the long dash (45 px); L30 «59–59b», a short dash (25 px, gaps 7 and 15 px) in the small type of the reference; N03 «13—14», the long dash of the small type of the notes (30 px, gaps 8 and 9 px). L17-L18: below the 2 of «23°» in L17 a dark blot between the lines; not transcribed.
Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Batt.», «Nallino»; italics: «ascensiones obliquae». L06-L07: Kh.'s rule in German quotation marks; L05 «„Sinus der Ergänzung“».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-15 px measured; «sagen :» in N01, 12 px).
